description: This file defines the tracing API for debugging and performance measurement in a Git-related project. It includes structures, macros, and function declarations for trace logging, environment control, and timing utilities.

classes.name: trace_key
classes.description: Structure representing a trace category or key, including its environment key, file descriptor, and internal state flags.

methods.name: trace_repo_setup
methods.description: Sets up tracing for a given repository.

methods.name: trace_want
methods.description: Checks if tracing is enabled for a given key.

methods.name: trace_override_envvar
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a key based on environment variable value.

methods.name: trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing for a specific key.

methods.name: getnanotime
methods.description: Returns high-precision current time in nanoseconds since epoch.

methods.name: trace_command_performance
methods.description: Logs performance data for a command.

methods.name: trace_verbatim
methods.description: Logs raw data verbatim under a specific trace key.

methods.name: trace_performance_enter
methods.description: Marks the start of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_performance_since
methods.description: Logs elapsed time since a start point.

methods.name: trace_performance_leave
methods.description: Marks the end of a performance measurement.
